title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
summary: A security researcher reverse-engineered an obfuscated bash script discovered on a Uniqlo t-shirt, tracing it through CDN/Akamai infrastructure to understand its purpose and behavior.
problem_solved: Exposes and decodes hidden obfuscated code embedded in retail product promotional materials.
why_valuable: Demonstrates supply chain security risks and practical reverse engineering techniques for analyzing obfuscated scripts.
